intentEvidence: Explorer Multi-Select fixes that inside the File explorer you already use, rather than replacing it with a view of its own.
motivation: The author built it to fix the difficulty of selecting several files and folders in Obsidian's File explorer.
problem: Selecting multiple files and folders in the default Obsidian File explorer is difficult, especially on mobile devices or when using complex selection criteria.

relations.evidence: Same selection goal; keeps core tree; touch selection mode and rule-based commands
Different surface: changes selection inside core File explorer
Same selection goal; extends core File explorer rather than replacing it
Broader selection controls: touch mode, rule commands and selection count
Same selection goal; works in core File explorer; touch support

summary: Adds selection mode, keyboard shortcuts, and rule-based selection to the File explorer for easier multi-selection of files and folders.
